This is the known unrelated R4-UI-0006 CRLF sensitivity in the static index byte comparison: the served raw bytes carry CRLF while read_text normalises to LF. It is line-ending specific, pre-existing, sits in a file this task did not touch, and disappears on the LF-normalised canonical form, where the same command reported Ran 579 tests, OK, 6 skipped, exit code 0, which is why the required commands are replayed there. Consequently a reviewer running the suite on a Windows checkout should expect this one failure and must not read it as an R4-ART-0007 regression. This task modifies no test or application file, and GitHub hosted CI on the canonical form remains the required confirmation.

The Layer AI usage threshold that would trigger reconsidering layer_ai as an image provider is still unset, and layer_ai stays DISABLED_UNTIL_CONFIGURED and absent from every route. The image route has no fallback, so a codex_imagegen outage stops art regeneration outright and any reissue of these assets would be blocked.

The managed provider path discloses neither a model name and version nor a per-call cost, so both are recorded as unavailable and model is null. If the provider swaps models behind the connector, a later regeneration could drift in style without any repository-visible signal; only the recorded prompts and file fingerprints tie these assets to their generation.

The provider source renders are held outside the repository, so the processing chain from source render to staged file can be replayed only from the recorded prompts, source-render hashes and the mechanical-processing list in docs/art/R4-ART-0007-generation-record.json. An independent verifier cannot reproduce the bitmaps from inside the repository alone.
